card.name: First word after a section heading
card.fires_on: The first word of body text right after a numbered or titled section heading in a drug label, such as Administration, Preparation, Local Anesthetics or Intervention. Typical words are When, If, Only, In, To, Do and All.

modes.label: After numbered headings
modes.description: Opening word of text following a numbered subsection title like 2.2 Administration.
modes.example: 2.2 Administration<< In>> general, titrate to the lowest dose

modes.label: After unnumbered headings
modes.description: Opening word after a heading such as Intervention or Clinical Management in an interaction table.
modes.example: Clinical Management<< If>> co-administration of BALVERSA with
